'''OK''' (Thai: '''โอเค''' ''OK'') is the 2017 ending song of the {{pmin|Thailand|Thai}} dub of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''. It debuted in [[SM001]]. It uses the same footage as its corresponding Japanese ending theme, [[Pose]].
